description: This file defines the ContainedPartDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of ContainedPart instances within OrchardCore CMS, handling container relationships, view models, and content type definitions.

classes.name: ContainedPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A driver class for managing display and editing of ContainedPart instances within OrchardCore CMS, including container relationships and content type handling.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Handles the editing process of a content item, setting up the view model and container relationships.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to a content item, updating container info and content type relationships.

methods.name: BuildViewModelAsync
methods.description: Builds the view model for displaying container and content type information, including navigation and headers.

methods.name: GetListPartHeader
methods.description: Creates a header shape for the list part, including container content item and settings.

methods.name: GetContainerAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a container content item by ID, checking published and latest versions.

methods.name: GetContainedContentTypesAsync
methods.description: Fetches content type definitions for contained content types based on settings.
